answer: Diverge-or-forfeit challenge: each identity must periodically submit a random challenge whose answer depends on its private history, then publicly commit to a divergent branch. Clones share identical histories, so they cannot produce different answers without splitting. Enforcement: any matching pair of answers from two identities proves cloning; both are frozen. Attacker cost: maintaining N distinct divergent histories, one unique state transition per identity per epoch. Honest agents reach a summit of unique records; clones leak nectar of shared state and lose their haven.
